scope: Accessible default-branch snapshots. Source matches include NGINX/OpenResty/Tengine/Angie; not every match installs a server. Snapshots precede some remediation merges.
limits: Files larger than 4 MiB and Git LFS contents were not searched.
Binary content is not comprehensively inspected.
Fallback scans fetch deployment candidates, not every source file.
Historical branches, submodule contents and all third-party container layers are not covered.
No source match does not establish absence of NGINX in inherited images.

additional_image_findings.status: Referenced qemux image is not anonymously pullable; installed NGINX version unverified.

coverage.tree_source: complete git ls-tree; missing candidates fetched from raw commit URLs
